_approach: The last-bar hype-stab trick: bar 1 keeps the halfstep frame under a rising tambourine bed; bar 2 fires a stack of off-beat perc and cowbell stabs standing in for the processed 'drop' / 'fire' / 'selecta' vocal chops sound-system culture places in the bar before a dubstep drop, climaxing on a crash on the final 16th. Ref: Point Blank 'How to Create a Dubstep Drop from Scratch'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
